# WasteWiz

> WasteWiz is a licensed waste removal and rubbish clearance company serving Manchester and Greater Manchester. Same-day service for house, garden, office and bulky waste clearance.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Waste removal in Manchester & Greater Manchester — services, coverage and free quotes.

- [Services](/services): Full list of clearance services offered.
- [Rubbish Removal](/services/rubbish-removal): General household and commercial waste removal.
- [House Clearance](/services/house-clearance): Full property clearances for homeowners, landlords and estates.
- [Garden Clearance](/services/garden-clearance): Green waste, soil and outdoor furniture removal.
- [Office Clearance](/services/office-clearance): Commercial furniture, equipment and office waste disposal.
- [Regular Collection](/services/regular-collection): Scheduled waste collection for businesses.
- [Bulky Items](/services/bulky-items): Furniture, appliances and mattress removal.
- [Deep Cleaning](/services/deep-cleaning): Post-clearance deep cleaning.
